schoolPressures.label: Harvest labour
schoolPressures.detail: Cane-cutting season pulls neighbours' sons out of school; Kiran is also expected to learn farming during holidays and harvest.

schoolPressures.label: Transport & safety
schoolPressures.detail: The family will not send Chaitra to PU college by shared auto or cycle on the highway.

schoolPressures.label: Delayed mill payments
schoolPressures.detail: A household waiting on cane payment cannot easily absorb transport, books or uniforms for a second child.

schoolPressures.label: Marriage enquiries
schoolPressures.detail: Relatives have begun informal enquiries about Chaitra's marriage, which become more common once a girl completes secondary school.

pressures: Kiran's harvest-time absences add up year after year, which is how a Class 8 boy drifts toward farm work instead of Class 10.
Unless a safe ride to college exists, Chaitra's schooling stops at Class 10 even though she is in school today.
A late mill payment means Kiran, the second child, is the one whose books and transport wait, so his year is what slips.
If the enquiries turn into a proposal, Chaitra's schooling beyond Class 10 would likely end there.
factorEffects.sanitation: If Puttaswamy's home lacked a proper toilet, his 16-year-old daughter Chaitra would feel it first; the card gives no sign this is his family's problem.
factorEffects.district: The factor flags the share of English-medium schools in Mandya. The card shows cane harvest, highway transport safety, mill payments and marriage enquiries as the pressures, not language.

changes.effect: Mandya ranks among the lowest in Karnataka for classrooms in good condition; repairing them would keep lessons running for his daughter Chaitra, 16.
Nearly every school here has toilets, but not all; for Chaitra, a working girls' toilet is part of what makes staying in school possible.

changes.factor: % Population Living in Households with Improved Sanitation
changes.effect: If his home lacked a toilet, Chaitra would face the safety and privacy worries that, with marriage enquiries, can end a girl's schooling.

lag.effect: Few of Mandya's schools have smart classrooms, so Chaitra gets little of the more engaging, digital teaching they offer.

schoolPressures.label: Chores & sibling-care
schoolPressures.detail: When Manjula's shift runs long, Keerthana minds her brother, cooks and does chores, competing with homework.

schoolPressures.label: Commute safety
schoolPressures.detail: The nearest government college is far, and families worry about unsupervised daily travel for a teenage girl.

schoolPressures.label: Factory wages
schoolPressures.detail: Garment work, even at minimum wage, is an immediate income; Keerthana joining her mother is openly discussed.

schoolPressures.label: Missing transfer certificate
schoolPressures.detail: Migrant families who move often fail to carry a transfer certificate, blocking re-enrolment in a new government school.

pressures: When her shift runs long, Keerthana minds her brother, cooks and does chores, so homework gets the leftover time.
The nearest government college is far and families worry about unsupervised daily travel for a teenage girl, so safety can end Keerthana's schooling.
Garment work, even at minimum wage, is immediate income, and Keerthana joining her mother is openly discussed.
Families that move often fail to carry a transfer certificate, which blocks re-enrolment in a new government school.
factorEffects.sanitation: If her one-room rented home shares or lacks a proper toilet, her 15-year-old daughter Keerthana would feel it first.
factorEffects.district: In Bengaluru Urban the district-level factor is the share of schools with a functional protected well, a school water-supply issue. The card shows chores, commute safety, wages and paperwork as the pressures, not water.

changes.effect: Bengaluru North's teachers are among the best trained in computers in Karnataka; for her daughter Keerthana, 15, that can make lessons clearer.
Most teachers here are women; for Keerthana, women teachers can make school feel safer when the commute already worries the family.
Bengaluru North leads Karnataka on computer labs; a working lab gives Keerthana digital skills that feel useful for a job, a reason to stay.

lag.effect: Continuous evaluation is weaker here than in most districts, so if chores and sibling care make Keerthana fall behind, it may be noticed late.
